# Open CoDesign Web

Open CoDesign Web is the local-first browser sibling of the Open CoDesign desktop design agent.
It runs a TypeScript/Node server and React interface, stores workspaces on a user-controlled Docker
volume, and previews `App.jsx` designs in a sandboxed browser frame.

- Project: https://github.com/OpenCoworkAI/open-codesign
- Documentation: https://github.com/OpenCoworkAI/open-codesign#web-app-docker
- License: MIT
- Health endpoint: /api/health
